        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    # Find full rows
    full_rows = set()
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[i])) == 1:
            full_rows.add(i)
    
    # Find full columns
    full_cols = set()
    for j in range(w):
        if len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(h))) == 1:
            full_cols.add(j)
    
    # Build output
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if i in full_rows or j in full_cols:
                out[i][j] = 2
    
    return out
